title: Lateness
description: Each employee's total late-arrival and early-leave minutes for the month. Days follow the lateness rule in HR settings.

locked.title: This month is locked
locked.body: The payroll for {month} is approved, so its lateness can no longer change.

discard.title: Discard unsaved minutes?
discard.body: You changed {count} rows in {month} without saving. Switching month discards them.

empty.title: No active employees
empty.body: Lateness is entered for active employees. Add employees first.

settingsError: The lateness rule couldn't load, so days can't be shown. Try again.
